notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - 200 NEW LEVELS!
notes.content:
[i]Emme Saves the Galaxy[/i] is back - with even more levels!

That's right, there are now 600 levels to beat, with tons of exciting new block types.

Here are some other features we added to version 1.2.0:
[list]
[*] All levels unlocked by default, so that you can skip around and play what you like!
[*] Streamlined level select screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - 200 NEW LEVELS!
notes.content:
[i]Emme Saves the Galaxy[/i] is back, with twice the levels!

That's right, there are now 400 levels to beat, with [b]tons of exciting new block types[/b].

Here are some other features we added to version 1.1.0:
[list]
[*] Mouse support
[*] "Fast-forward" helper feature to allow players to skip past difficult levels after five failed attempts
[*] Colorblind mode
[*] Option to turn off screen quaking
[/list]
